source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'TEMP_DIMM_ZONE1~4' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) sensor get "<SENSOR>"` reading + threshold; user judges (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES treats `TEMP_DIMM_ZONE1~4` as one literal sensor and claims FULL evidence although the fallback is truncated. It does not define the four zones, memory population, aggregation source, threshold capability, UI mapping or credential-safe access.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly requires all four zones, memory topology, empty-zone semantics and preserved logs. V3.1 additionally distinguishes a zone aggregate from individual DIMM or PMIC/TSOD telemetry and requires the algorithm/source and fitted-memory applicability to be explicit.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 873/2291 accepts the literal range query and output presence without proving four zone identities, physical membership, aggregation semantics, freshness or complete threshold/UI coverage.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1036 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the source range notation; ED-34 treats topology, specification and Script availability as readiness inputs; ED-35 keeps this static display case read-only without claiming dynamic thermal coverage; ED-38 requires credential-safe complete evidence, no clearing, writes or automatic retries, and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify the four DIMM thermal-zone records represented by `TEMP_DIMM_ZONE1~4` are present and human-readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, and that each zone's value, units, status and supported thresholds match the platform sensor specification.
original_method: Resolve the range notation into the platform's four actual zone records, map every zone to its memory region and unchanged WebUI row, then compare complete read-only fields against the approved DIMM-zone specification under the recorded memory population and operating state. Logs and sensor settings remain unchanged.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the fitted-memory topology, zone membership and zone-computation definition plus per-zone acceptance data. Automation can collect the four resolved records and matching WebUI rows; a human resolves aggregation or empty-zone ambiguity and owns the verdict. This row does not authorize memory stress or thermal stimulus.
required_inputs: Exact board/BMC/BIOS and fitted CPU-channel-DIMM-slot topology with the membership of DIMM zones 1 through 4
For each zone, the physical sensing source and aggregation rule, stable SDR name/number/type/entity/instance and Dashboard/Server Health row
Per-zone units, scaling/rounding, tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health and unavailable/empty-zone semantics
Recorded memory workload, power state, airflow/fan policy, timestamp alignment, allowed update lag and any approved reference telemetry
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions, supported transport/cipher and protected authentication
Pinned immutable accessible `sensor.git` revision/checksum with safety review, or an approved manual collection method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or system logs; existing memory thermal, ECC and platform events are useful context and clearing is not necessary for this passive display check.

Do not issue `sensor get 'TEMP_DIMM_ZONE1~4'` unless the vendor proves that exact text is a literal record. Enumerate and retrieve four stable zone identities; a single response or shell-like interpretation cannot establish four-zone coverage.

Do not equate a DIMM-zone aggregate with an individual DIMM, TSOD or PMIC temperature without the approved computation and membership map. Preserve the raw zone value and any corroborating component telemetry separately.

Do not add memory stress, alter fan policy, change thresholds or heat hardware to make readings move. Static readability/specification coverage does not validate alarm transitions or thermal-control response.

Respect each SDR threshold capability mask: unsupported limits need not appear, while missing required limits, stale records, duplicated zones or a zone mapped to the wrong memory region require explicit disposition.

Do not truncate fallback inventory, expose passwords using `-P`, assume cipher suite 17 or execute the unavailable internal Script before review. Stop without automatic retry if any zone identity or UI/OOB correlation is uncertain.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the exact platform, fitted memory topology, client and Script; build a four-row zone-to-memory expectation matrix before selecting records.
Capture complete raw/API identity, reading, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp for zones 1 through 4 plus each corresponding unchanged Dashboard and Server Health row.

Compare each zone independently with its specification and approved aggregation/reference rules at the recorded operating state; report empty, missing, duplicated, swapped, stale or divergent zones separately.
Preserve redacted evidence and current logs; perform no clearing, stress, threshold/fan change, retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the fitted-memory topology and the exact DIMM membership and sensor-source/aggregation semantics of zones 1 through 4.
Provide the per-zone threshold, tolerance, status, freshness and empty-zone acceptance matrix and approve the collection tool or Script.
Review all four zone results independently and issue the formal verdict without using one zone or individual-DIMM telemetry as a substitute for another zone.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Likely unfit literally because `~` is range notation rather than an IPMI wildcard, while `head -100` can omit later records and threshold fields. The command also lacks memory/zone mapping and WebUI correlation, exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the complete sensor repository, resolve four vendor-defined DIMM-zone names or IDs, retrieve each through protected read-only access and correlate each unchanged Dashboard and Server Health row with the approved memory-zone matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_DIMM_ZONE1~4, Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; the Review layer interprets the four-zone notation without editing Master or adding active thermal load.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a four-row evidence matrix keyed by stable zone identity and physical memory membership, recording the zone algorithm/source, raw/API and both UI views, then compare each passive reading and supported threshold with the versioned Project specification.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact board, populated memory configuration, BMC/SDR and WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, CPU/DIMM population, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform memory topology, DIMM thermal-zone and SDR definitions, component thermal limits, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves a four-zone shorthand into explicit records, defines zone membership and aggregation, validates every UI/raw mapping and protects access/evidence without active stimulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Passive zone readings do not validate individual-DIMM accuracy, memory-load response, threshold assertion, fan-control response or shutdown protection unless separately approved and executed; a zone aggregate cannot prove every member sensor.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fitted-memory and zone map, aggregation/source definitions, per-zone acceptance data, operating-state/timing rules, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Zone composition may change with memory population; a zone can be computed rather than physical, empty regions may be absent or unavailable, and UI values can be rounded or delayed.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM or component telemetry as an approved alternative or corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent four-zone identity, membership, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. Individual DIMM/PMIC readings or one zone do not automatically equal all four zone aggregates.
expected_evidence: Board/BMC/BIOS identity, populated CPU-channel-DIMM-slot topology and the approved zone1-to-zone4 membership plus sensing/aggregation definition
Complete four-zone sensor inventory with stable IDs, readings, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamps
Redacted Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading evidence mapped separately to each zone and physical memory region
Per-zone Project specification and recorded memory load/power/airflow state with scaling, tolerance, freshness and optional reference comparison
Explicit disposition of empty, missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or UI/OOB-divergent zones and pinned Script/tool security evidence
No-clear/no-write/no-stress/no-retry proof, final BMC/memory health, coverage limitations and engineer-owned four-zone verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The tilde expression is unsafe as a literal command operand but reasonably denotes zones 1 through 4, and Items, UI Procedure and Criteria align on read-only zone display/specification validation. Exact topology and computation semantics are Project readiness inputs, not an irreducible contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is identifiable as passive DIMM-zone sensor validation. The zone map, aggregation definitions, expected limits and access artifacts can be supplied by the Project, so readiness is pending rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE and rejects a literal one-name query/truncated fallback as proof of four independently accepted zones.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on hybrid read-only classification while sharpening the distinction between aggregate zone evidence and component telemetry, and making population-dependent zone computation part of acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-exists reasoning with explicit four-zone identity, memory membership, aggregation and complete field/UI evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents a literal tilde lookup, a single/partial record or unrelated individual-DIMM temperature from being presented as complete four-zone coverage, while allowing valid population-dependent empty zones to be judged by the approved matrix.
independent_technical_reasoning: A DIMM thermal zone is often a platform grouping or controller-derived maximum rather than a one-to-one DIMM sensor. Its meaning therefore depends on installed memory and the zone algorithm. Four stable identities, membership and per-zone acceptance are required; name presence alone cannot show correct thermal data or thresholds, and passive readback cannot prove dynamic protection behavior.
